body:
Reported Player(s): I dont remember the full username but he was a mod named zeus
 Rules Broken: Kicking me for no reason only after i thought some other play had been using hacks and i said for him to turn them off ( speed hacks ) but then he told me that it was scout, which i didnt know got speed. Then i said sorry for trying to report him and he forgave me, but i was kicked before that by zeus and when i came back i had asked him to stop kicking me for no reason, then after that game we played another where i saw a developer or something haha and asked him where i could report a mod for kicking for no reason, then i got banned. This happened 2 days ago, and i am only posting this now because i am banned for 2 days and i cant go on the server to set up my account for the website.
 Evidence: In the format of unedited and images or video (not cropped, straight from the game).
